IS 9001:2025.text: Plastic containers shall be made from virgin food grade polymers; recycled plastics are strictly prohibited.
Filled bottle containers shall withstand a free-fall drop test from 1.2 m height onto a flat concrete surface without rupture or leakage.
Containers must withstand and maintain a hydrostatic pressure of 200 kPa for 5 minutes without leakage or deformation.

IS 9004:2025.text: All pre-packaged food items must display energy value, proteins, carbohydrates, total sugars, added sugars, fats, and sodium per 100g or per single serving on the principal display panel.
Presence of gluten, nuts, dairy, soy, or shellfish allergens shall be clearly highlighted in bold type.
Expiry date or Use By date must be prominently stamped on the packaging.

IS 9002:2025.text: Toys intended for children under 36 months must not contain small parts that fit into the small parts cylinder (31.7 mm diameter) to eliminate choking hazards.
Accessible metal and glass edges on children toys shall be smooth or protected to prevent laceration injuries during normal play.

IS 9003:2026.text: Protective helmets shall be dropped onto flat and hemispherical steel anvils at 7.5 m/s with peak acceleration transmitted to the headform not exceeding 300g.
The chin strap retention mechanism shall not slip more than 25 mm under a dynamic 50 kg load test.

IS 374:2019.text: Electric ceiling fans of 1200 mm sweep shall deliver a minimum air flow of 210 m3/min at rated voltage with energy service value exceeding 4.0 m3/min/Watt.
Fan motor windings must incorporate thermal overload protection.
Suspension downrod and safety shackle must withstand a 1000 N tensile pull test.

IS 9005:2025.text: Domestic pressure cookers must be fitted with an operating pressure regulator, safety relief valve, and fusible safety plug that releases pressure safely before reaching 300 kPa.

IS 9999:2026.text: Domestic LED lighting luminaires shall comply with Risk Group RG0 (Exempt) or RG1 (Low Risk) photobiological safety standards.
